title: Navbar
summary: The top navigation: brand, links, dropdown and mega menus, right-aligned actions, sticky option, and a hamburger that folds the links below 1024px.

props.name: noFold
props.description: For a host that owns the menu on narrow screens (the app shell's drawer): below 1024px the links stay hidden and the hamburger is not shown, and the actions stay at the end of one non-wrapping row while the brand shortens first.

cssProperties.name: --pk-navbar-padding
cssProperties.description: The bar's inline padding. A shell that already pads its header row sets it to 0 so the brand and the actions meet the header's own edges.

a11y: A nav landmark; the hamburger is a button with aria-expanded controlling the links; the current link has aria-current="page".
mobile: Links fold behind a 44px hamburger and stack full width; dropdown menus open inline.
